title: Joining a percussion workshop
passage:
JUNIPER STEPS COMMUNITY STUDIO
Workshop welcome page

The two-hour workshop starts with a demonstration, then lets visitors try three kinds of percussion. No instrument is needed to attend. We lend small drums for the exercises; visitors may bring their own shakers if they want to compare their sound.

For the first exercise, sit anywhere you can see the instructor's hands. Stay in the same seat when we switch instruments. Helpers bring a drum to each seat, so do not join the line for the instrument cupboard. That line is only for people returning loaned drums at the end.

We are testing a new quiet table near the back. It will not be used for the loud group exercise. Visitors at that table can still follow the exercise by tapping a pad, and they may tell a helper at any time if they want to move back to the regular tables.

The workshop ends at noon, but the recording desk remains open until twelve thirty. It is for those who wish to hear a sample from the demonstration, not for extra time with the loaned instruments.

杜松階社區工作室
工作坊迎新資訊

兩小時的工作坊從示範開始，之後訪客可試三種打擊樂。不必自備樂器。我們會借出小鼓供大家練習；想比較聲音的人可以自帶沙鈴。

第一項練習請坐在能看見老師雙手的位置。更換樂器時請留在同一座位。助手會把鼓送到每個座位，所以請不要到樂器櫃前排隊。那條隊伍只供課程結束時歸還借來的小鼓。

我們正在試用後方的新安靜桌。那桌不做大聲的團體練習；坐那裡的訪客仍能敲練習墊跟著做，也隨時可以告訴助手想回一般桌。

工作坊中午結束，但錄音櫃檯開到十二點半。櫃檯讓想聽示範片段的人試聽，並非延長借用樂器時間。
